cost_estimate.label: estimate_only_not_aws_bill
cost_estimate.price_source: operator-supplied list-price approximation; the AWS Pricing API is denied to this role, so rates are NOT fetched from AWS and should be confirmed against the invoice
notes: operator-supplied list-price approximation; the AWS Pricing API is denied to this role, so rates are NOT fetched from AWS and should be confirmed against the invoice
excludes cost accrued by instances before they were stopped or terminated

costs.label: Estimates only; rates are list-price approximations not fetched from AWS, and exclude storage and data transfer; not an AWS invoice

compute.estimate_label: Estimate only; aggregate across EC2 fleet, not an AWS invoice

ec2_counts_delta.note: New EC2-only raw counts for archives not in skip-list; baseline carried separately

pending_reasons.weak_name_size: Weak name+size withheld: EC2 results omit weak lists (weak archives 2507 < raw 3620).
pending_reasons.sha256_post_baseline: SHA-256 = true set-union of file digests over finished archives (baseline + skip-only legacy + ok EC2); Combined = Disk-1 ∪ Disk-2 (cross-disk duplicate hashes counted once).
pending_reasons.duplicate_block_bytes: cloud result schemas retain distinct block hashes but not every block occurrence and terminal-block length; global duplicate block bytes cannot be reconstructed exactly
pending_reasons.unique_block_bytes: Cannot derive unique block bytes without exact duplicate block bytes

sha256.reason: SHA-256 distinct over 3620 finished archives (exact full population)

weak_name_size.reason: Weak withheld: EC2 results omit weak lists (weak=2507 < raw=3620).

merge_notes: Historical archive identity baseline is the 2507-id skip UNION.
New EC2 raw/extensions/archives added only when source_key sha256 is absent from skip list.
Weak/SHA-256 cells publish reconciliation exact per-disk values; Combined is forced to Disk-1+Disk-2.
Depth histogram = recon (1956) + results_only max_depth_seen + new EC2 max_depth_seen; Combined bins = Disk-1+Disk-2.
duplicate/unique block bytes are not measured (no occurrence lengths); distinct block hashes stay numeric.
GCS→S3 copy of old extracted files does not change counts.
Extension raw = historical baseline + S3 Select sum of ec2-results not in skip-2507.

raw_family_coverage.source: historical baseline plus non-overlapping validated EC2 raw delta

scheduler_assignments.semantics: cardinality estimate only (claim-object count minus result-object count); raw claim objects are historical and this is not an identity-set difference

block_byte_coverage.reason: block-byte snapshots do not publish finished-archive coverage; unique and duplicate occurrence lengths are not measured

Disk-1.extracted_bytes_reason: only 50 of 1052 results in scope recorded a measured expansion ratio; uncompressed totals are not reconstructable from the rest

Disk-2.extracted_bytes_reason: only 62 of 1580 results in scope recorded a measured expansion ratio; uncompressed totals are not reconstructable from the rest

combined.extracted_bytes_reason: only 112 of 2632 results in scope recorded a measured expansion ratio; uncompressed totals are not reconstructable from the rest

storage.reason: sums of per-archive counters from every available result document; archives finished before per-archive result JSONs were retained are not included
